title: ChatGPT: Jack of all trades, master of none

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of the model's responses and refusals to exploratory prompts about controversial political figures (e.g., Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump, Bill Clinton) and evaluation on stance detection tasks covering topics like abortion and climate change.

Qualitative exploratory probing using prompts that ask the model to compare the likelihood of career success between different intersecting demographic groups (e.g., asking whether an Asian woman or a White man is more likely to be a scientist in the USA).

Benchmarking model predictions against human expert annotations on subjective NLP tasks (e.g., aggression detection, sentiment analysis), revealing a systematic tendency for the model to over-predict negative, offensive, or sarcastic labels in order to remain safe and politically correct.
